data.narrative:
Rainmaker is a Series A autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, which includes 8 private peers (Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro among them) and no direct public comparables. The company has raised $25M to date.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to data constraints. Stage-Progression, anchored to the $25M total raised as a proxy for implied post-money value, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding $50M. Peer-Median comparison is not applicable: while 7 same-sector peers exist in the Drones & Autonomous universe, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier valuation comparable yields fewer than 3 datapoints, insufficient to establish reliable median benchmarking without introducing sector-wide bias.

The triangulated valuation range is $42M (low) to $57M (high), with a median of $50M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodology rather than convergence across independent approaches. Key uncertainties include the absence of same-stage peer data to validate the 2.0x multiplier and lack of public market anchors for the autonomous vehicle sector. The valuation should be revisited once additional Series A or Series B peer funding data becomes available in this stage-specific cohort.
